TakeWalker:

(Also, “wherefor” means “why”, pedantic fyi.)

Even more pedantically: When both “wherefore” and “why” were commonly used in English, they had different meanings.  “Wherefore” meant “what caused this” or “as a result of which” and “why” meant “with what rationale.”
